---
title: "Overview Scroll"
subtitle: "Mouse-wheel navigation for RevealJS overview mode"
format: revealjs
revealjs-plugins:
  - OverviewScroll
---

## What is Overview Scroll?

- Press **O** to enter overview mode
- Scroll horizontally to move between slide columns
- Scroll vertically to move between rows within a column
- Press **O** again (or **Escape**) to return to the selected slide

## Column A — Slide 2

This is the second horizontal slide.

::: {.fragment}
Scroll right in overview mode to reach Column B.
:::

## Column B — Slide 3

This is the third horizontal slide.

::: {.fragment}
Scroll left to go back.
:::

## Installation

```bash
quarto add AJBogo9/overview-scroll-revealjs
```

Then add to your document front matter:

```yaml
revealjs-plugins:
  - OverviewScroll
```
